select_algorithm_from_choices: select the best algorithm from a list of Triton or extern kernel choices using autotuning benchmarks
benchmark_triton_kernel: benchmark a Triton template kernel against input tensors to measure execution time
create_extern_kernel_choice: create an extern kernel choice wrapper that binds input nodes and layout for kernel selection
generate_triton_template: generate a Triton template kernel with grid function, input nodes, and layout configuration
log_autotune_results: log autotune benchmark results showing top-k kernel choices with timing percentages
